about: Centers that exist but are not listed on chabad.org. precision: 'exact' = real location, 'area' = rough spot in the right neighbourhood, 'city' = city centre (address unknown). note is shown on the dot's card. url, site, siteHe: the center's own page elsewhere (a center not on chabad.org), linked on its card as "Open on <site>" / "לדף ב<siteHe>". center-type: {name} as chabad.org's types (Mikveh, Jewish Community Center…), shown on the card. fixes: corrections to chabad.org's own listings, by center id (city, lat, lon; or personnel where chabad.org lists no one — a fix without lat keeps the listing's approx flag).
